channel.title: Burrow and Butter
channel.description: Tested recipes, chef vs. home cook features, and local restaurant reviews from Nick (Chicago) and Xavier (Houston).

item.title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon Beurre Blanc
item.description: Restaurant-quality salmon with perfectly crispy skin and a silky French butter sauce. Easier than it looks, impressive every time.

item.title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
item.description: Golden, crispy edges with creamy centers. These smashed potatoes are the perfect side dish that looks impressive but couldn't be easier to make.

item.title: Why Mise en Place Matters (Even When It Doesn't)
item.description: A chef and a home cook debate whether prepping all your ingredients before cooking is essential—or just Instagram-worthy fussiness.

item.title: The Publican - Chicago
item.description: An honest review of The Publican in Chicago's Fulton Market, featuring their legendary pork program and excellent oyster bar.

item.title: The Perfect Burger: Chef vs. Home Cook
item.description: Xavier brings dry-aging and custom blends. Nick uses grocery store ground beef and a cast iron pan. Which approach makes the better burger?

item.title: Georgia James - Houston
item.description: A professional chef's review of Georgia James in Houston, serving some of the best upscale Texas BBQ in the city.
